segments.title: A lost city just told us its NAME
segments.say: A lost Maya city just told us its real name.

segments.title: Found by laser scans
segments.say: Laser scans spotted it under the jungle in Mexico.

segments.title: They named it 'No road'
segments.say: Archaeologists named it Minanbé: there is no road.

segments.title: Its real name: SAKIL
segments.say: Now carvings suggest its real name was probably Sakil.

segments.title: Its king was called 'Bat'
segments.say: Its ruler was called Soots. That means, Bat.

segments.title: A rival city 40 km away
segments.say: And a rival city forty kilometers away carved a captive from Sakil.

segments.sub: King 'Bat': cool name or scary? Comment
